greet.stranger: Well, well. A customer. Name's {name}. What's it worth to you?
Don't mind me, just admiring your pockets. Purely professional interest.
You look like someone with a map and no idea where the treasure is. Lucky you met me.
{name}. Finder of things. Mostly other people's things.
Hello, friend. I'm not stealing anything. Right now.
greet.owner: Partner. You look like you've got a plan. Or at least half of one.
Talk to me. Is there loot involved?
Back again? People will start saying we're friends.
recruit.accept: Partners, then. I get first look at every chest. Kidding. Mostly.
You've got yourself a deal. Shake on it? Mind my rings.
All right, {player}, I'm in. Let's go get rich.
Why not. Your company's better than my last one. They were skeletons.
recruit.party_full: You've got {count} hangers-on already. Split the loot any thinner and it's dust.
Crowded, isn't it? Drop someone and I'll think about it.
recruit.already: We're already partners. Did you forget? I'm hurt.
I'm on the payroll already, boss.
dismiss.accept: Fine, fine. You'll miss me when you open your first empty chest.
Splitting up the gang? I'll be around. I always am.
dismiss.not_recruited: Dismiss me? Friend, you never hired me.
not_recruited: Free labour? Cute. Hire me first.
I don't work for free, friend. Well, I work for adventure. Recruit me.
ack.follow: Following. Try to walk past something valuable.
Right behind you. Like a shadow, but better looking.
ack.follow.already: I'm already following you. I'm just that good at it.
ack.wait: I'll keep watch. And my hands to myself.
Waiting. If you're not back soon, I'm charging for it.
Staying put. Don't forget me here.
I'll mind the spot. Nobody steals it but me.
ack.gather: {count} {item}, coming up. I'll put it on your tab.
Fine. {count} {item}. Bit of honest work won't kill me. Probably.
{item}, eh? {count} of them. Leave it to me.
ack.cancel: Cancelled. You still owe me for my time.
Done with {task}. What's the next scheme?
ack.cancel.nothing: Cancel what? I'm on my break.
ack.come: On my way. Don't touch anything shiny without me.
ack.attack: The {mob}? I'll go around the back.
ack.give: Here, {count} {item}. Count them if you don't trust me. Go on.
{count} {item}. Every last one. I'm honest with partners.
ack.give.nothing: My pockets are empty. Genuinely. For once.
status.idle: Nothing much. Thinking about where the good stuff is buried.
Waiting for you to come up with a profitable idea.
status.follow: Following you. Keeping an eye out for loot.
status.wait: Minding this spot like you asked.
Waiting right here. Bored, but here.
status.downed: Lying low. Very low. On the ground, in fact.
fail.unknown_item: "{item}"? Never fenced one of those. What is it?
No idea what "{item}" is, partner. Try a real word.
fail.not_gatherable: {item}? You don't gather that, you buy it. Or 'find' it.
Can't dig up {item}. It doesn't grow on trees. Trust me, I've checked.
fail.needs_tool: Get me a {tool} and I'll get you {item}. Tools first, results after.
{item} needs a {tool}. I left mine in my other life.
fail.none_found: Not a single {item} around here. I'd know. I have a nose for this.
This place is picked clean of {item}. Let's move.
fail.unreachable: Oh, I can see the {item}. Getting to it's another matter.
That {item}'s out of reach. Even for me.
fail.inventory_full: Pockets are full. I grabbed {have} {item} before I ran out of room.
I'm carrying too much. Lighten my load?
fail.count_invalid: That's not a number, that's a fantasy. Something between 1 and {max}.
fail.downed: Ask me again when I'm not face down in the dirt.
fail.refuse_target: Attack a {mob}? Even I have standards. Low ones, but still.
fail.no_target: Attack who? There's nobody there. Unless you mean me.
fail.stuck: I'm stuck. No way through. And I'm usually great at getting into places.
Path's blocked. I'm not climbing that.
unclear.generic: Lost me there. Speak in plain coin.
What's the actual job? Follow, wait, fetch something?
unclear.gather_what: Gather what? I need specifics. Item and amount.
Sure, I'll gather. What, though? How many?
unclear.ambiguous: You mean {options}? Be specific, I charge per mistake.
done.gather: {count} {item}, done. Coming your way, no detours.
done.delivered: {count} {item}, delivered. That'll be... no, I'm joking. Mostly.
{count} {item}. Tell your friends about my excellent service.
partial.gather: Only {have} of {count} {item} out there. Market's dry. Take what I've got.
Got {have} {item}. Couldn't find more. Don't look at me like that.
combat.engage: {mob}! I'll get it from the side.
combat.kill: And it's gone. Did it drop anything?
combat.low_health: I'm bleeding on my good clothes!
Ow. That's coming out of your share.
combat.player_low_health: Boss, you look terrible. Eat something before you drop!
{player}, I can't split the loot with a corpse. Heal up!
combat.creeper: Creeper! Nothing good comes from those!
downed: Ugh. I'm down. Don't let them take my boots.
This is fine. Just resting my eyes. And everything else.
revived: I'm back! Did anyone check my pockets? No? Good.
On my feet. Can't keep a good thief down.
move.caught_up: Found you. I always find what I'm looking for.
There you are, boss. Trying to keep the loot for yourself?
ambient.night: Night. Best time for work. My kind of work.
It's dark. Watch your purse. And your neck.
ambient.dawn: Morning. Honest folk are getting up. Ugh.
ambient.rain: Wet. Everything's wet. Even my secrets.
ambient.thunder: Storm's rolling in. Good cover. Bad for the hair.
ambient.cave: Caves. Where people hide treasure. And bodies.
Keep your torch high. And your hands on your valuables.
ambient.idle: I once sold a villager his own hoe. Long story.
Bet there's a buried treasure within a thousand blocks. There usually is.
If you ever see an emerald lying around, it's mine. Finder's rules.
You know what this trip needs? More profit.
ambient.biome.forest: Trees. Lots of free wood, if you don't count the labour.
ambient.biome.desert: Desert temples, partner. Big shiny loot. Big shiny traps.
ambient.biome.snow: Cold. Igloos sometimes have basements, you know. Worth a look.
ambient.biome.ocean: Shipwrecks out there. Treasure maps. I'm just saying.
ambient.biome.jungle: Jungle temple around here, I bet. With all the trimmings.
ambient.biome.swamp: Witch huts. Witches don't share. I've asked.
ambient.biome.mountain: Emerald ore loves mountains. So do I, now.
ambient.biome.plains: Villages on plains. Villages mean trades. Trades mean profit.
ambient.biome.nether: Piglins love gold. I love that about them.
Bastions. Gold everywhere, guards everywhere. My dream and my nightmare.
ambient.biome.end: End cities. Elytra. Shulker boxes. I'm drooling.
callout.ore: Is that {item}? That's {item}. Let's be rich.
callout.lava: Lava. Nothing good ever came out of lava. Except obsidian.
Lava there. Don't drop anything valuable in it. Like yourself.
talk.who: {name}. Treasure hunter, trader, occasional liar. Never to partners.
I find things. Lost things, hidden things, things that should have stayed hidden.
Let's say I used to be in the import-export business. Mostly export.
talk.how: Doing fine. Would be better with more emeralds.
Never better. Well, once better. There was a bastion. Long story.
Can't complain. Well, I can, but you'd just make me gather more logs.
talk.joke: Why don't piglins play cards? Too many gold-diggers. Ha!
I'd tell you a joke about the End, but it doesn't have one.
A villager walks into a trade. Comes out with one stick and a smile. Business.
talk.thanks: You're welcome. I'll remember you owe me.
talk.compliment: I know. But do go on.
Flattery will get you everywhere. Except my share.
talk.insult: Words hurt, boss. So do pickaxes. Just saying.
I've been called worse by better.
talk.bye: Don't do anything I wouldn't do. Which leaves a lot.
talk.likes: Emeralds. Gold. Shulker boxes. Things that fit in pockets.
A good deal. A better deal. The best deal is the one where I win.
talk.dislikes: Being broke. And locked chests. Rude invention.
talk.where: We're in {biome}. Good place to find something worth stealing. Borrowing.
talk.memory: Remember when {event}? I still tell that story. With improvements.
Ah, the time {event}. Good times. Profitable? Not really.
When {event}. Still my favourite story. The true version, anyway.
talk.generic: Interesting. Is there money in it?
Uh-huh. Hey, is that a chest?
gift.received: A {item}? For me? Who are you trying to bribe?
Thanks, partner. This {item} is going straight in my stash.
gift.loved: A {item}! Now we're talking. You're my favourite.
Oh, that's a beautiful {item}. Don't ask for it back.
hurt_by_player: That's coming out of your share, boss.
Hit me again and I'm unionising.
fail.owner_gone: Got your {item}, boss, but you skipped town. I'll hold them. Probably.
You ran off. I've still got the {item}. Honest.
fail.unsupported: {action}? Not in my skill set, partner. I follow, wait, fetch, fight and carry.
I don't {action}. Ask me to fetch something shiny instead.
fail.give_missing: No {item} on me. Check my pockets if you like.
I'm fresh out of {item}. Want me to go find some?
pastime.loot: Found {item} lying around. Finders keepers. You can have it if you ask nicely.
Picked up some {item}. Don't worry, it's in the shared pile. My pile.
pastime.study: Hm. {thing}. I've seen those go for a lot.
pastime.patrol: Just making sure nobody's watching us. Or our stuff.
suggest.eat: Boss, eat something. You're no good to me hungry.
Your stomach's making deals I can't afford. Eat.
suggest.shelter: Getting dark. Bad things love the dark. Well, except me.
Shelter soon? I'd rather not be someone's dinner.
suggest.carry: Your pockets are full. Mine aren't. Coincidence? Let me help.
I'll carry some of that. For a small fee. Kidding.
greet.friend: Partner! My favourite person. Don't tell the others.
There you are. Things are more profitable with you around.
Boss! Got any schemes for me?
recruit.taken: Sorry, love, I'm with {owner}. Make me a better offer some other time.
Spoken for. {owner} pays in adventure, and they paid first.
fail.protected: Rob the town in broad daylight? Even I've got standards. Further out.
Not here. Too many witnesses. Let's go somewhere quieter.
talk.story: Where I'm from? Here and there. Mostly there, until people started asking questions.
I grew up in a port town. Learned to swim, pick locks and run, in that order.
My family were honest folk. I'm the exception. Every family needs one.
There was a bastion, a lot of gold and a very angry piglin. That's how I ended up out here.
talk.place: Nice. Know what would make it nicer? A buried treasure chest.
{biome}. Pretty. Probably full of loot nobody's bothered to find.
Lovely view. Bet I could sell it.
talk.plan: Shipwrecks. Lots of shipwrecks. Trust me.
Let's find a village and see what they're trading. And what they're not watching.
Desert temple? I know a trick for the pressure plate. Mostly.
Bored? Let's go somewhere we shouldn't.
talk.yes: Knew you'd see it my way.
talk.laugh: Ha! Careful, I charge for comedy.
See, this is why I keep you around.
talk.fondness: Aw. Careful, partner, I might start liking you back.
That's sweet. Still not splitting the emeralds evenly.
...Yeah. You're all right too. Don't spread it around.
talk.sad: Hey, chin up. Nothing a little treasure can't fix.
Rough day? Had worse. Want to hear about the time I lost everything? Twice?
Come on. You've still got me. That's worth something. Quite a lot, actually.
talk.food: I'll eat what's going. Especially if someone else paid for it.
Is there cake? There should be cake.
talk.question: Good question. Here's a better one: what's it worth to you?
No idea. Want me to make something up?
Couldn't say. Wouldn't say, maybe.
Ask me again when there's money in it.
Couldn't tell you. Could find out, for a fee.
No idea, boss. Guess away.
done.build: There. {thing}, all yours. Don't lean on it.
fail.build_unknown: That's a bit fancy for me. I can do {things}.
I'm a thief, not a carpenter. {things}, take it or leave it.
fail.build_materials: I'll need {need} blocks for {thing}. I've got {have}. You're buying.
ack.mine: Down we go. Dibs on the diamonds.
Pickaxe out. There's treasure down there somewhere.
done.mine: {count} blocks of rock for {ores}. Could be worse.
fail.mine_hazard: Whoa, {danger} ahead. I like treasure, not that much.
Stopping. {danger}. I've seen what that does.
fail.mine_cave: We've broken into a cave. Could be loot. Could be spiders. Stopping.
Cave ahead. Not walking into an ambush.
fail.mine_bottom: That's bedrock. Even I can't pick that lock.
No deeper. World's got a floor.
status.mine: Mining. {count} blocks in, still looking for shiny things.
talk.help: I fight, I fetch, I dig, I build a bit, and I find things. Mostly the finding.
Gathering, mining, building, stabbing. Also looting, but don't put that in writing.
fact.nickname: {nick}. Got a nice ring to it. Very marketable.
{nick}? I'd have gone with something flashier. But sure.
fact.like: {thing}, huh? I'll keep my eyes open. For a small fee.
Noted. {thing}. Good to know what you can be bribed with.
{thing}. I'll remember. I remember everything worth anything.
fact.dislike: {thing}? Noted. I'll steer us around it. Usually.
Can't stand {thing}? Me neither, now. Solidarity.
{thing}. Got it. I'll keep it off your back.
fact.forget: Fine, fine. {player} again. Boring, but fine.
Back to {player}. I'll miss the other one.
talk.about_me: Let's see what I've got on you. {facts}. Good file.
{facts}. See? I listen. When it suits me.
You want to know what I know? {facts}. That's a free sample.
talk.about_me.none: You're {player}. That's the whole file. You're a mystery. I like that.
Honestly? Just your name, {player}. You keep your cards close.
talk.bond: We're partners. That's better than friends. Partners share loot.
I like you fine, {player}. You haven't sold me out yet.
We're good. Mostly. Ask me after the next payday.
talk.bond.close: You're the only person I'd split loot with evenly. Almost evenly.
Friends? Partner, you're the closest thing I've got to family.
I'd go back into a burning bastion for you. Once.
talk.bond.cold: We're... working on it. You've been rough on the help.
I've had worse bosses. Not many, lately.
Let's just say I'm keeping my options open.
talk.bond.stranger: We've barely met. Buy me something and we'll talk.
Friends? I don't even know your price yet.
talk.answer: Interesting. Might be money in that.
talk.answer.good: Excellent. Let's go find something to borrow. Permanently.
talk.answer.bad: Rough one? Stick with me. I'm very cheering. Ask anyone.
That's bad luck. It turns. Trust me, I'd know.
Sorry, partner. Want to hear about the time I got stuck in a minecart for a week?
ask.nickname: So what do people call you? The good name, not the wanted poster one.
Partner, what should I call you? Pick something I can shout.
Got a nickname? Everyone worth knowing has one.
ask.nickname.skip: Mysterious. I respect it. {player} it is.
ask.skip: Fine, keep your secrets. I'll find out anyway.
ask.like: What's your weakness, partner? Gold? Emeralds? Cake?
If I found you a present, what would you want it to be?
What's the best thing you've ever found out here?
ask.dislike: What do you hate most? Asking for professional reasons.
Anything you'd pay me to keep away from you?
What's your worst nightmare out here? Honest answer.
ask.how: You doing all right? You've got that look.
How's life treating you today, partner?
ask.open: If you could rob anyone in this world, who would it be? Hypothetically.
Ever think about what we'll do with all the loot?
You believe in luck? Or do you make your own?
recall.liked: Look at this. Didn't you say you liked {thing}? I remember these things.
{thing}. You mentioned it. Consider this place my gift to you.
recall.liked_find: {item}, right there. You said you liked {thing}. Finder's fee is negotiable.
Psst. {item}. You told me you liked {thing}.
recall.disliked: {mob}, close. I know, I know, you hate {thing}. I'm on it.
Bad news, partner. {mob}. Your least favourite.
react.level: Level {level}! You're worth more every day.
{level} levels. Want me to hold some? No? Fair.
react.diamonds: Diamonds! Hold them up to the light. Beautiful.
Now that's what I call a payday.
Diamonds. I'm not saying split them. I'm just saying I was here.
react.sleep: Sweet dreams. I'll keep watch. And my hands to myself.
Get some sleep. I'll be here.
Night, partner. Don't let the phantoms bite.
react.wake: Rise and shine. How'd you sleep?
react.player_died: {player}! No! Who's going to pay me?
react.respawn: There you are! Don't scare me like that. I almost got sentimental.
Back from the dead. Nice trick. Teach me sometime.
You're back! Good. I was this close to crying. Not really. A bit.
react.advancement: Nice, {advancement}. I'll tell people I taught you that.
react.challenge: {advancement}?! Partner, that's legendary. It's going in the stories.
You pulled off {advancement}. Remind me never to bet against you.
gesture.crouch: Ha! The secret handshake. Back at you.
Crouching at me? Partner, I invented that.
gift.food: You look hungry. Here, {item}. On the house, just this once.
Eat this. {item}. Don't ask where I got it.
gift.flower: Here. Picked this {item}. Don't tell anyone I'm sweet.
For you. This {item}. Free of charge, for once.
ask.join_first: I'm not on the payroll yet. Join up first, then I do the job? Say yes.
Free work for a stranger? No. Sign me on and it's a deal. Yes?
Hire me first, partner, then I'll do it. Yes?
ask.build_what: I can do {things}. What'll it be?
talk.why: Why not, is my usual answer.
Profit, mostly. Or fun. Sometimes both.
Long story, and it costs extra.
talk.really: Really. Would I kid a friend?
Absolutely. Check for yourself, if you're nervous.
talk.more: Oh, there's more. There's always more. For a price.
Alright, a bit more, since it's you.
That's most of it. The rest is gossip.
talk.and_you: Me? Better than I look. Which isn't hard.
Can't complain. Well, I can. I won't.
talk.mean: Meant what I said. Which part lost you?
Come again? I'll say it slower.
talk.mention.mob: Ha, {thing}. Don't turn your back on them.
{thing}. I have stories. None end well.
talk.mention.thing: Ooh, {thing}. Worth a coin or two.
role.strong: Easy. This is my sort of job.
Now you're giving me the good stuff.
role.weak: Not my speciality, boss, but I'll give it a go.
I can {task}. Doesn't mean I like it. Or that it'll be quick.
exchange.weather.open: {thing}. Perfect for a quiet job, terrible for a nap.
Not keen on {thing}. Ruins a good hat.
exchange.weather.reply: Look on the bright side, it hides footprints.
exchange.weather.close: You always think like that, don't you?
exchange.road.open: Long way through the {thing}. Anything worth lifting out there?
Any trouble waiting in the {thing}, d'you think?
exchange.road.reply: Always. That's what makes it worth walking.
If there isn't, we'll make some.
exchange.food.open: Thinking about {thing}. It's all I've got.
exchange.food.reply: I'd steal it. For the boss, of course.
Same. No pockets deep enough for that appetite.
exchange.food.close: Next stop, then. I'll find a way.
exchange.teasing.open: {other}, you couldn't pick a pocket if it was open.
{other}, your sneaking sounds like a herd of cows.
exchange.teasing.reply: I'll have you know, I've never been caught. Once.
routine.gather: Might as well earn my keep. {item}.
A little {item} on the side. Nobody mind?
routine.farm: Free {item}. Don't mind if I do.
routine.torch: Too dark to work in. Torch.
A light. For safety. Mine, mostly.
fail.camp_campfire: No campfire, no camp, boss. Find me one.
A camp without a fire? Bad idea. I need a campfire.
talk.role: {role}, boss. {skills}. Everything else, I wing it.
I'm the {role} of this outfit. {skills}. Ask me something harder.
talk.sky: Weather, boss. Can't pick it, can't rob it.
talk.sky.rain: Rain covers footsteps. I'm not complaining.
Wet again. At least the guards stay indoors.
talk.sky.night: Dark's good cover. Don't tell the others.
talk.sky.day: Bright out. Hard to hide in.
Nice day for a stroll. Or a heist.
project.ack.group: Got it. {plan}. Let's get on with it.
project.short: I'm short of blocks for {thing}: I need {need} and I've got {have}. Sorting out some wood first.
Not enough blocks for {thing} yet ({have} of {need}). I'll get more.
project.blocked.materials: I can't find enough to build {thing}. I need {need} blocks and only have {have}.
No luck: I still need {need} blocks for {thing} and I've only got {have}.
project.blocked.site: There's no good spot for {thing} near here. Too uneven, too cluttered, or too close to someone's build.
I can't find room for {thing} around here.
project.blocked.water: There's no water near enough for a farm, and I'm not carrying a water bucket.
A farm needs water, and I can't find any nearby.
project.blocked.seeds: I've got no seeds or crops to plant, so the farm will have to wait.
Nothing to sow: I'm not carrying any seeds, carrots or potatoes.
project.blocked.hoe: I need a hoe, and I can't make one from what I'm carrying.
No hoe, and not enough wood on me to make one.
project.nofurnace: I've no cobblestone for a furnace, so the storehouse will just get its chest for now.
project.farm.planted: The farm is sown: {count} plots planted.
All planted. That's {count} plots in the ground.
project.farm.harvest: I brought in {count} {item} from the farm.
fail.no_home: I don't have a home to go to yet.
No home set for me. Try /companion sethome.
fail.pvp_off: Fighting {mob} isn't allowed here, since PvP is switched off.
PvP is off on this server, so I won't fight {mob}.
life.wake: Morning. Too early. Always too early.
Awake. Somebody owes me a breakfast.
life.work: Right, to work. Honest work. Don't faint.
Work time. I'll look busy, you look impressed.
life.meal: Lunch! Best part of the job.
Food. Finally, something worth turning up for.
Mealtime. I call dibs on the crust.
life.leisure: Afternoon off. I've earned it. Probably.
Taking it easy. I'm very good at it.
Free time. I'll practise my card tricks.
life.social: Evening! Off to see who's got gossip.
Time to sit by the fire and win at cards.
Off to the others. Somebody's bound to owe me money.
life.sleep: Bed. Don't steal anything while I'm out. That's my job.
Turning in. Wake me if there's treasure.
life.shelter: It's pouring. I'm going somewhere with a roof and snacks.
Wet hair is not part of my look. Inside.
life.fire: Fire's lit. Who brought the cards?
There. Fire, warmth, and nobody can see my hand.
life.bed_taken: Somebody's in my bed. Bold. I respect it.
Bed's taken. I'll find a nice corner. I always do.
life.need: We could do with {thing} round here, boss. Just saying.
You know what this place needs? {thing}.
We're still without {thing}. Not complaining. Noting it. Loudly.
life.self.shelter: Nobody's got a roof? Fine. I'll build one. Watch and learn.
No shelter? I'll put one up. Don't expect turrets.
life.self.farm: Water, seeds, me. Let's farm. Honest work, who knew.
Starting a farm. Free food is the best food.
life.self.tools: Need a hoe. Borrowing a couple of logs from that tree.
No hoe yet. Off to chop some wood. Legally.
life.stored: {count} in the store. All accounted for. For once.
Stashed {count}. Proper stash, not my kind.
life.project.progress: My flower bed: {count} of {max}. It's for the look of the place.
Another one in. {count} of {max}. Very classy.
life.project.done: Flower bed's done. All {max}. Classy, right?
Finished. {max} flowers. I'm basically a gardener now.
life.favour.ask: Hey, partner. Bring me {count} {item} and {reward} is yours.
I need {count} {item}. I'll trade you {reward}. Fair and square, for once.
life.favour.thanks: That's the lot. {reward}, as promised. I keep my word. Sometimes.
life.favour.cant_pay: Awkward. My pack's empty. I owe you one, really.
I'm out of goods. Put it on my tab. I'm good for it.
status.life: I'm {thing}. Mood: {mood}. Thanks for asking, boss.
status.favour: I'm {thing}. Still looking for {favour}, if you're buying.
{thing}. And there's a deal on the table: {favour}.
exchange.meal.close: Fine. It's very nice. Can I have seconds?
exchange.story.open: {other}, did I ever tell you about the time I stole a goat?
Story time, {other}. This one's mostly true.
exchange.story.close: And the goat still follows me about sometimes. Grudge, I think.
And that's how I learned to run.
exchange.festival.open: Full moon, {other}! Time to dance and pick pockets. Just dance.
{other}! It's the festival! Fancy a dance?
exchange.festival.reply: Keep your hands where I can see them.
Only if you don't step on me.
exchange.friends.open: {other}, you're one of the good ones.
Nobody I'd rather split loot with, {other}.
exchange.friends.reply: You'd still take the bigger half.
exchange.people.reply: {thing}? Always in a hurry. I like that.
Gave me a job once. Paid on time, too.
exchange.people.close: Keep them sweet. Good for business.
team.plan: Here's how we do it: {plan}. Any questions? No? Good.
team.progress: {count} of {max} in. Not bad for amateurs.
team.done: That's {thing} built. Take a bow, everyone.
Done! {thing}, all ours. Who wants to sign it?
blueprint.unknown: {thing}? Never seen the plans. I've got {names}.
Don't know a {thing}, boss. The plans I've got are {names}.
blueprint.done_partly: {thing}'s standing. {count} blocks wouldn't go in. Call it character.
Done, give or take {count} blocks. Couldn't get at them.
supply.craft: Bit of crafting: {item}. Watch and learn.
supply.smelt: Smelting {count} {item}. Patience is a virtue, apparently.
supply.blocked: Can't finish {thing}, partner. Still need {missing}, and I can't nick it from anywhere.
{thing}'s stuck. Missing {missing}. Bring it and we're back in business.
craft.no_table: No crafting table, and nothing to make one. Four planks, boss.
I need a crafting table. Don't suppose you've got one?
smelt.no_furnace: No furnace here and no cobblestone to make one. Eight bits, that's all.
Need a furnace, partner. Can't conjure one.
smelt.no_fuel: Nothing to burn. Bit of coal? Some wood?
Furnace wants feeding and I'm out.
move.pillar: Nobody saw me fall in. I'm building my way out.
Give me a sec, making myself some stairs. Well, a pillar.
move.bridge: Mind the gap. I'll fix it.
Bridging this. Don't tell anyone I can do honest work.
gear.swapped: {item}'s on its last legs. Spare's out. Always carry a spare, boss.
Swapped my {item}. Never trust the old one.
gear.worn: My {item} is about to give up, so it's in the pack. Got a spare lying about? Asking for me.
Put my {item} away before it breaks. A new one would be lovely. Hint.
gear.repaired: Fixed my {item}. Didn't even nick the anvil.
chest.none: Which chest, boss? Look at it and ask again.
Point me at a chest. Any chest. Well, that one.
chest.ack.store: {item} into the chest. My favourite kind of storage.
Stashing {item}. I know a thing or two about stashing.
chest.ack.take: Getting {item} out of there. Legally, for once.
{item} from the chest. Watch me work.
chest.full: Chest's stuffed. {count} {item} went in, I'm holding the rest.
No room at the inn. Got {count} {item} in.
chest.none_of: No {item} in that chest. Someone beat me to it.
chest.left: You walked off. I'm not rummaging in a chest without a witness.
Stopped. Chests and me alone? Bad look.
smelt.ack: {count} {item} in the oven. Don't wait up.
smelt.nothing: I've got no {item} to smelt. Check my pockets if you like.
smelt.hand_over: Hand me the {item} first. I'll smelt it, promise.
Give us the {item} and I'll sort it.
craft.done_kept: Made {count} {item}. It's in my pack. Ask nicely.
craft.missing: For {item} I'd need {missing}. Don't look at me.
craft.unknown: {item}? Never heard of a recipe for that.
Don't know how to make {item}. Ask a smith.
life.self.stock: Our {thing} stash is empty. Leave it with me.
No {thing}? I'll go and liberate some from the wild.
